lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Frostbite Fjord! The ice giants pivoted from pillaging to timeshares. Historians agree this is worse.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're not buying anything.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero, NOBODY plans to buy a timeshare. That's the terrifying part. Guard your signature with your LIFE.

lines.speaker: The Presentation
lines.text: SLIDE ONE: WELCOME. SLIDE TWO: IMAGINE... OWNING... WINTER.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: How many slides are there?

lines.speaker: The Presentation
lines.text: SLIDE THREE: DO NOT ASK ABOUT THE SLIDES.
The corner floe. A desk carved from a glacier. Behind it, a giant whose breath is a cold front.

lines.speaker: Permafrost
lines.text: I hear you sat through the ENTIRE presentation and bought NOTHING. Remarkable. I respect it. I also cannot allow it.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Is there a "leave quietly" package?

lines.speaker: Permafrost
lines.text: Everything is a package. That one costs a battle. Shall we... close?

lines.speaker: Permafrost
lines.text: The contracts... void... the fjord... free... my parka... just a regular parka now...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Four thousand timeshare owners released! The penguins are shredding paperwork! It's SNOWING CONTRACTS!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Prettiest snow I've ever seen.
On the slopes below, a green shape in seven scarves carves elegant turns. A tie flutters from each scarf.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Is that... GERALD? On VACATION?

lines.speaker: Gerald (distant)
lines.text: PTO IS A RIGHT, NOT A GIFT! Also I'm expensing this! WHEEEEE—

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I'm glad he's doing well. I'm also afraid.
Eight arms surface from the fjord. Each holds a pen. Each pen is uncapped. This is a closing.

lines.speaker: Karkinos
lines.text: I sense hesitation. Hesitation is just a signature that hasn't happened yet.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: GUARD YOUR INITIALS, HERO.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Foreman Flintbeard was here selling his FORGE as a timeshare. His own forge! Fractional ownership of an anvil!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Did anyone buy in?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Fourteen penguins and, devastatingly, me. We close on Tuesday. ANYWAY — Permafrost's office. Mittens on. Sign NOTHING.
